entries.title: A practice signal changes RB2; a starter announcement does not change WR1
entries.question: Does Wednesday participation justify Braelon over Pollard, and what does confirmed McCarthy actually resolve?
entries.why_it_matters: The spare $600 can change the RB role purchased; quarterback identity and receiver opportunity are different uncertainties.
findings: Hall was DNP Wednesday with quad injury; no final designation was posted.
Jets report Braelon receiving some work as well as leading recent rushing opportunity; the retained Week6 review separates that role from his actual score.
Titans list Spears' absence as rest, not a newly established injury opening for Pollard.
Giants confirm McCarthy starts. Coach describes continuing concepts with possible play-mix changes; no receiver-specific improvement was quantified.
entries.interpretation: Provisionally choose Braelon while accepting the unresolved Hall-return risk. Keep Nabers on prior involvement evidence; confirmation of a starter does not make relief-quarter production a normal baseline.
alternatives: Pollard restores $600 flexibility and remains a credible rushing-role alternative if Hall returns.
A screened Marks swap adds Houston concentration; no fresh role evidence was qualified to select him.
Retaining LaPorta avoids doubling Giants pass-catching exposure solely on the quarterback announcement.
uncertainty: Hall is not ruled out; a return or materially shared backfield could invalidate the Braelon lead-role premise.

entries.lineup_effect: Pollard→Braelon +$600; all other eight retained. Total$50,000/$0. Removes Pollard/Titans shared exposure, keeps Stroud/Nabers opposing passing-game exposure and no direct Texans receiver. No new Rams concentration. Same old external model snapshot totals138.0; its injury/QB assumptions are not qualified.
change_triggers: Hall's next participation and final game designation; if he returns with starter role, reconsider Braelon before freeze.
A supported receiver role/availability change or current official slate/price correction.
Giants protection and actual target distribution; McCarthy starting alone does not justify a second Giants receiver.
carry_forward: Check Hall Thursday/Friday participation and final status before freeze; DNP is not OUT.
Test the conditional Braelon role using actual RB carries and targets, rather than treating a strong or weak score as proof.
Assess McCarthy's full-game pass distribution/protection separately from Nabers scoring.

Provisional research lesson: distinguish changed football information from changed information quality. Fresh current official export failed, while public prices and retained eligibility remained inspectable.

expectations.subject: Braelon Allen
expectations.statement: Conditional on Hall remaining unavailable, Braelon retains the lead share of Jets RB carries; some receiving involvement is possible, without a target-floor claim.
expectations.support: Official Wednesday DNP for Hall and recent Braelon rushing/receiving work.
expectations.uncertainty: Hall may return; Isaiah Davis, game script and returning pass catchers can alter opportunity.
expectations.challenge: Hall returning to the lead role or another back taking most RB carries challenges this selection.
expectations.observe: Compare actual Hall status, Jets RB carries and targets. Separate volume from efficiency/TDs. Routes remain unassessable without inspected data.

expectations.subject: Malik Nabers / Giants QB
expectations.statement: McCarthy is expected to start; retaining Nabers relies on central receiving involvement, not extrapolating his relief-quarter passing yardage.
expectations.support: Official Wednesday starter announcement plus retained Nabers involvement evidence.
expectations.uncertainty: Play mix, protection and full-game target distribution under McCarthy remain unmeasured.
expectations.challenge: Starter change or substantially reduced Nabers involvement challenges the condition/role premise.
expectations.observe: Record starter and substitutions, team attempts and receiver targets; assess opportunity separately from yards/TDs.
